title: Sketching the API for an interview prompt

kcs.statement: Each functional requirement maps to at least one endpoint with a method, path or RPC name, parameters and response, e.g. POST /urls {long_url} → {short_code}.
Any endpoint that returns a list (feed, messages, search) must be paginated, and cursor pagination stays correct when new items are inserted while offset pagination does not.
An interview API sketch names how callers are identified (API key or token) because it enables per-user rate limits and abuse controls later in the design.

problem_ideas: Write the three endpoints for a URL shortener (create, redirect, delete) with request and response shapes
A feed endpoint uses ?page=3; show how a new post makes the user see a duplicate, then fix it with a cursor
Choose REST or gRPC for a mobile client API vs an internal service-to-service call and justify each
Find the missing endpoint in an API sketch for a chat app given its functional requirements
Pick the HTTP status code for a redirect from a short URL (301 vs 302) and explain the analytics trade-off
Redesign a chatty API that needs 5 calls to render one screen
